name: carry_shoulder
text: A person stands carrying a long heavy rolled carpet resting across the right shoulder. The right elbow is bent and lifted sideways, the right hand is beside the right temple steadying the load above the shoulder. The left arm hangs down. Torso leans slightly left to balance. Maintain this carrying pose throughout without walking.
